targets.instruction: Put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket.
targets.human_analogue: Use two distinguishable food containers and one basket. Put each container into the basket, leaving both inside.

targets.instruction: Put the white mug on the left plate and put the yellow and white mug on the right plate.
targets.human_analogue: Use two distinguishable mugs and two plates. Put the first mug on the left plate and the second mug on the right plate.

targets.instruction: Put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it.
targets.human_analogue: Begin with the bottom drawer open. Put a bowl inside and then close the drawer fully.
